name: Tanla Platforms Limited
summary: Tanla Platforms Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides cloud communication platforms as a service solution to enterprises in India and internationally. The company operates Wisely Platform, an API-led intelligent platform-of-platforms, which serves as a unified hub for digital interactions to craft solutions and provide experiences in the realm of communication, privacy, and security.
